native.dimensionUnits: dp/sp; specimens map one unit to one CSS px for visual inspection.
native.authority: User-pinned camera-photo.jpg and camera-filters.jpg under .impeccable/references; current source resolves implementation facts.
native.previewStates: Specimens are static source-derived examples. Filter-card and ruler focus geometry mirrors current native source; other CSS focus affordances support browser inspection. Android owns the documented keyboard actions.
native.tonalRamps: Synthesized OKLCH inspection aids; not shipped tokens.

contrastFades.top: min(18% viewport height,136dp), edge-black to transparent.
contrastFades.bottom: min(46% viewport height,380dp), transparent at 0, fade-middle-black at .4, edge-black at 1.

inlineFilters.pixels: Actual camera preview with full-strength preset matrix; no reference screenshot or stock photo assets.
inlineFilters.strength: 0–100 native range; 2-point ticks, 10-point majors, ±5 accessibility actions.
inlineFilters.close: Photo or Android Back; shutter position preserved.
inlineFilters.landscape: Zoom gesture ruler hidden while strip is visible.

keyboardFocus.card: 2dp red outer card outline,4dp corners; white selected preview border remains.
keyboardFocus.strength: 1.5dp red outline,6dp corners; inset2dp horizontally,1dp vertically.
keyboardFocus.keys: Left -2 percentage points; Right +2; Home0; End100. Up/Down delegate to native focus navigation.
keyboardFocus.redraw: Card and strength range invalidate on focus changes.

zoomRuler.actions: Relative drag, tap multiply/divide1.15, accessibility multiply/divide1.1 or set-progress.

keyboardFocus.outline: 2dp red on existing panel boundary,20dp corners.
keyboardFocus.keys: Up/plus/equals multiply1.1; Down/minus divide1.1; Home minimum; End maximum.
keyboardFocus.redraw: Invalidate on focus changes. Focus alone leaves idle fill/thumb sizes unchanged.

compositionArrow.geometry: Straight, rounded8dp shaft/head, alpha185/255; head14dp axial length.

freeCrop.stroke: White1dp over dark3dp; white2dp corners up to12dp or shorter dimension/4.
freeCrop.persistence: Completed retained crop stays visible after guidance ends; output centered with rotation-aware axes.

referenceGrid.cross: 1dp red,11dp arms; visible when composition is inactive.

native.artisticDiscoveryPresentation: One short subject label/reason in existing status; subjective selection signals, not objective quality grades.

narrative.overview:
A familiar native camera puts the live image behind a spare black, white and red control system. Bare white icons and text establish the controls; red indicates the selected stop, active task or ready composition. The manual shutter is the largest white shape.

The user-supplied photo and filter screenshots pin this visual replacement. Their durable language is monochrome contrast, restrained red selection, a double-circle shutter and inline image previews. The app expresses its own rear-camera-only capabilities through recent-photo and AI controls. Auxiliary provider settings keep native neutral day/night form semantics with red theme accents.
keyCharacteristics: Full-screen live image with local black edge fades.
Bare white drawn controls and red selected text.
Stable shutter with actual camera-backed inline filter previews.
Fine reference geometry, bold translucent movement arrow and continuous zoom.

rules.name: Bare Controls
rules.body: Keep ordinary camera controls transparent at rest. Use the small filled chevron, transient status and narrow ruler only where the implementation establishes a local backing.

rules.name: Red State
rules.body: Use red to identify selected controls, ruler position and ready guidance. Keep filter-card selection a white outline.

rules.name: Native Type
rules.body: Use Android system sans and the implemented compact sp roles; no display typography layer is established.

rules.name: Stable Shutter
rules.body: Opening or closing inline filters must keep the manual shutter in the same position and available for capture.

rules.name: Edge Contrast
rules.body: Support bare white controls with local top/bottom black fades and small backings; preserve the center of the live image without an opaque scrim.

dos: Do preserve full-screen preview, system insets and at least 48dp interactive targets.
Do use red for active camera text and white for the selected filter border.
Do populate filter cards and the recent-photo control with actual camera or saved-image pixels.
Do keep the shutter fixed when showing filters and close the strip through Photo or Android Back.
Do honor disabled system animation for filter reveal, local search and automatic framing.
donts: Don't bring filled colored tiles or a modal filter sheet into this camera surface.
Don't copy reference branding, beauty controls, video modes, front-camera switching or unsupported optical focal lengths.
Don't replace live filter previews with sample photographs.
Don't present subjective AI ranking as an objective image-quality score.
